mktemp -d; realpath; rm -rf -- $TMP (on refusal and EXIT trap)

blocking.issue: Per-channel writer set W and commit count use `git log` without --stdin/tips, i.e. HEAD only, while paths, E and N use all refs. Output depends on the checked-out branch (not recorded), so determinism breaks and Q8 YES_LOCAL is false. Paths only on non-HEAD tips get W=empty, which is reported as IND[writer_overlap=0] or CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=0].

N is built from a subset of K-STATUS's own paths, so W(K-STATUS) contains N and overlap_norm>0 by construction. Every K-STATUS record (e.g. PROGRAM_STATUS.md) is forced to NORM_SOURCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT whenever any register-type path exists. This is a forced negative that mirrors the known executor defect.

The path universe holds tip paths only, so E excludes only the current candidate names. Commits on renamed, moved or deleted historic versions of channel files (including rename commits) put the channel's own writers into E. The known 'own writers as executors by construction' defect returns through history.

E is not an executor set. It includes committer e-mails (a shared GitHub platform committer for squash/web/UI-rebase commits; integrators) and every non-candidate doc/governance path. As a result, overlap_exec>0 is close to forced and NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec] does not reflect genuine cross-role authorship, which contradicts PROTOCOL-B section 3.

K-DEPLOY (deployment/configuration STATE files, release notes, tfstate) is put in the config-rule group: Q2=CONFIG_RULE and Q5=NO_BY_TYPE without reading content. Existence does not decide Q5, so it must be NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK. This is a forced negative.

nonblocking.issue: Q5 NO_BY_TYPE for K-CI/K-HOOK/K-CODEOWNERS/K-SIG/K-LOCALHOOK is a type argument made without reading content; prefer ND, or declare it as an assumption.

Q7 INDEPENDENT cannot be reached for any channel, and Q6 has a single outcome. The headline is a constant written before any data is seen. Defensible for existence-only scoping, but must be stated explicitly.
The tip-only path universe reports channels deleted or renamed before the tips as NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE although they are in the captured history; the label should say 'at tips'.

Repo-local config is not isolated (log.follow affects l.91-92); GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS/GIT_CONFIG_COUNT are not unset; reference overrides (core.fsmonitor=false, diff.renames, log.decorate) were dropped.
The peeled tag type is not checked (l.50). A tag pointing to a tree or blob becomes a tip and makes git log --stdin fail, so E and N are empty (logged, exit 1).
The identity guard fails open: a grep error (rc 2) prints PASS (l.162-166).
Errors from cat-file in the signature loops are not checked; tags are counted per ref; x509 tag signatures are missed.
In a linked worktree, OUT is not checked against git-common-dir.
ls-tree runs without -z, so C-quoted special paths fail the :(literal) pathspec and get IDs computed over the quoted string.
Unsalted SHA-256 path IDs of predictable paths can be reversed with a dictionary.
Writes outside OUT: $TMP holds plaintext e-mails (removed on EXIT, not on SIGKILL); mkdir -p may create parents of OUT.
refs/stash and refs/notes are included in the ref set, so results depend on the local stash and notes.

Protocol/script mismatches: the Q4 content_timestamps=ND qualifier is missing; K-SIG has no overlap counts; K-LOCALHOOK Q4 'NONE' is outside the vocabulary; Q8 conflates reproducible with independently verifiable; the Q2 ND branch is dead code; the N token 'authoriz' is reachable only if another K-STATUS token also matches; the script is 167 lines (> ~150).
The headline token 'NIF_A' is not defined in any input; it refers to an outside hypothesis label.
Only top-level docs/knowledgeos/ is excluded (meets the spec). ROOTS.txt also lists .claude and claude; confirm they hold no programme artefacts, or declare them.
